verdict.rationale: Ramp is a proprietary SaaS finance platform, but its first-party CLI is documented as open source on GitHub (ramp-public/ramp-cli). That gives a readable source for one piece of the product surface, not the core platform. missing for 10: source availability for the core Ramp platform, an explicitly named open license (the evidence says only "open-source"), and independent confirmation of the repository's license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
